biotools.summary: gisttools is a Python package and set of Jupyter notebooks designed to compute the free energy of solvation of molecules on a 3D grid using Grid Inhomogeneous Solvation Theory (GIST). It allows for detailed analysis of solvation energetics (energy and entropy contributions) around proteins and small molecules.
